newKeys.en: The image is missing or cannot be decoded. Refresh the gallery.
newKeys.zh: 图片不存在或无法解码，请刷新画廊。

newKeys.en: Redrawing from the selected illustration. You may close the gallery while you wait.
newKeys.zh: 正在基于所选画卷重绘，可关闭画廊等待。

newKeys.en: Redraw complete; saved as a new illustration.
newKeys.zh: 重绘完成，已保存新画卷。

newKeys.en: The illustration or current campaign is no longer available. Reopen the gallery.
newKeys.zh: 画卷或当前战役已失效，请重新打开画廊。

newKeys.en: The original image file no longer exists. No item was created.
newKeys.zh: 原画文件已不存在，未创建物品。

newKeys.en: Enter an illustration description for NPCs to read when you show them the item.
newKeys.zh: 请填写画卷介绍，NPC 展示时需要读取这段内容。

newKeys.en: The illustration item could not be created. Nothing was added to the inventory.
newKeys.zh: 未能创建画卷物品，背包未增加物品。

newKeys.en: The illustration description could not be saved: {ERROR}
{ITEM} is already in your inventory. Its description was updated; no duplicate was added.
newKeys.zh: 背包中已有{ITEM}，已更新介绍，未重复添加。

newKeys.en: {ITEM} was added to your inventory. You can show it to NPCs using Show Item during a conversation.
newKeys.zh: 已将{ITEM}放入背包；可通过对话中的“展示物品”向 NPC 展示。

newKeys.en: The illustration could not be added to your inventory. Check your inventory and try again.
newKeys.zh: 画卷未能放入背包，请检查背包后再试。
Enter 回车截取第 {COUNT} 张 · Esc 取消
已截取 {COUNT} 张，是否开始生成？
